review_scope: Read-only execution-policy review of one-group continuations for the two Bifrost groups not reached by the series-03 fail-stop invocation.

conclusion.basis: The committed C5 driver accepts mode=one for exactly one member of the fixed 20-group roster, validates and appends to existing series-03 state, preserves terminal attempts and monotonic counters, and emits a series summary only after every fixed group has a completed row. Explicit runs of only the two unstarted groups are distinct from retrying the failed Scala attempt. The root approval binds the reviewed contract but names the original serial launcher hash; issue a continuation addendum binding the two new launcher hashes before execution.

source_and_plan.worktree_note: The worktree contains many pre-existing untracked evidence and acquisition files. This review preserved them and wrote only its assigned review file.

authorization.human_instruction: Ok use v0.14.4 of bifrost, and run a benchmark of it as part of the new target for v0.9.2
authorization.continuation_addendum_needed: Bind the exact supervision-02 and supervision-03 launcher hashes, their one-group scopes, and serial ordering. This review does not extend approval or authorize either launch.

observed_execution_state.stop_ownership_observation: The root stop reconciliation records all 74 exact recorded PIDs absent at 2026-11-01 16:38 UTC. That is time-bounded evidence; recheck immediately before each launch and after the preceding invocation terminates.

driver_behavior: The CLI parser accepts one and serial-fail-stop; mode one requires exactly one ID from the fixed Bifrost roster.
With existing C5 rows, mode one validates the committed contract, prior ledger rows, progress journal, invocation receipts, and attempt links before appending.
A group with a completed series-03 attempt is rejected; a non-completed Scala attempt remains recorded and is not retried by either proposed group invocation.
The per-group policy allows at most two new target slots, rejects an unclosed series-03 namespace, and preserves monotonic global and per-group numbering.
The serial-fail-stop rule applies to the serial mode. One-group invocations are recorded separately and must be run serially with a fresh terminal and ownership check between them.
A completed one-group invocation does not imply target completion. Because Scala remains non-completed, the target summary must remain absent and read-only reconciliation must remain incomplete.

proposed_sequence_if_root_addendum_appro.historical_smoke_attempt_note: The unclosed bifrost-smoke-attempt-02-series-02 is historical consumed evidence. Preserve it; do not reuse or repair its attempt ID.

policy_analysis.invocation_result_interpretation: Each one-group command may report that its own invocation completed. Even if both groups complete, the overall target is 19 of 20 completed groups because Scala is still failed; verify must report incomplete with no series summary.

fresh_checks_required_before_execution: Re-read the current source and plan commit, confirm the contract remains exactly the approved SHA and clean at HEAD, and confirm the fixed driver hash still matches the contract.
Confirm no older launcher, analyzer, writer, or invocation is active and the shared analyzer lock is available. Recheck after Smoke reaches a terminal state and before TypeScript.

Require the driver's fresh 127 GiB launch-resource check and one-group disk preflight to pass, including the 125 GiB continuous free-space floor and exact working, retention, scratch, and source-projection limits. Stop on any guard failure.
Confirm each exact series-03 attempt, execution, cache, and normalized-report output path is unused. The driver refuses to reuse existing paths; do not override that behavior.

After Smoke, verify its terminal receipt and append-only ledger/progress hash chain, no active process ownership, and unchanged group/global counters before considering TypeScript. Stop for root review if status is non-completed or accounting differs from the expected next attempt.
